description.en: The unique identity of the ID Verification request.

description.zh:
是否允许裁剪人脸图片：

- T：允许剪裁

- F（默认）：不允许剪裁
description.en:
Specifies whether to allow trim of the face image. Valid values:

- T: Trim is allowed.

- F (default): Trim is not allowed.
The device token, which is used for risk identification.
The Base64 encoding of the photo.
The IP address of the user network.
The mobile phone number of the user.
The bucket name of the authorization-granted OSS bucket.
The file name in the authorization-granted OSS bucket.

description.zh:
客户服务端自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题。
取值最长为32位长度的字母数字组合，请确保唯一。
description.en: The custom business unique identity on the client side, which is used for subsequent troubleshooting. The value can contain up to 32 alphanumeric characters. Make sure the value is unique.

description.zh: 认证场景ID。该ID在控制台创建认证场景后自动生成。
description.en: The ID of the authentication scenario. This ID is automatically generated after you create an authentication scenario in the console.

description.zh: 您自定义的用户ID（最长100个字符），请保持唯一。
description.en: The custom user ID (up to 100 characters). Make sure the value is unique.

title.en: Passive liveness detection for face images

descriptions.zh: 调用LivenessFaceVerify接口对人脸图片进行活体检测。
descriptions.en: Calls the LivenessFaceVerify operation to perform liveness detection on a face image.
